auth.lite.deferred: Google, Microsoft, SSO an passkey go load wen you press dem.

auth.mfa.body.app: Put di 6-number code from Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator abi app wey be like dem.
auth.mfa.body.sms: We send di code go {hint} for SMS. E go work for 10 minutes.
auth.mfa.code.label: 6-number code

auth.mfa.sms.slow: SMS fit take reach 2 minutes wen network full. E never enter?

auth.error.validation_failed: Some tin wey you type never correct. Check di boxes wey we mark for down.
auth.error.invalid_credentials: Dis email an password no match. Check say you no make mistake, an check caps lock.
auth.error.account_locked: You don try to enter too many times.
auth.error.mfa_code_invalid: Dat code no match. Check your authenticator app, den try again.

auth.error.mfa_challenge_invalid: Enter again make you fit continue.
auth.error.resend_too_soon: Wait small before you ask for anoda code.
auth.error.sso_domain_not_found: We no see SSO for {domain}. Check how you spell am, abi ask your IT people whether dem don set SSO for Kasuwa.
auth.error.otp_invalid: Dat code no match. Check am, den try again.
auth.error.otp_expired: Dat code don expire. Code dey last ten minutes.
auth.error.otp_too_many_attempts: You don try too many times. Ask for new code.
auth.error.not_authenticated: Enter again make you fit continue.
auth.error.not_implemented: Dis part of Kasuwa never ready.

admin.roles.intro: Roles na wetin dey decide who fit see who record. Every role dey see im own record plus everything wey the roles under am get.
admin.roles.dragHint: Drag one role put on top anoda one to change who e dey report to, or pick “Dey report to” for di side panel.

admin.fls.title: Field-level security
admin.fls.intro: Pick who fit read or edit every field. Any field wey no get read access dey hidden everywhere: list, report, export and di API.
admin.fls.scope.note: Dis settings dey work for permission sets across di whole workspace. If you wan give one programme different rules, give im people anoda permission set.

admin.audit.title: Audit log
admin.audit.intro: Every admin, security and data action for dis workspace. Nobody fit edit or delete di entries, and we dey keep dem for 7 years.
admin.audit.ip.notShown.why: IP address na personal data. “We no show am” mean say dis column no dey available to you; e no dey tell you whether dem record address or dem no record am.
admin.audit.diff.redacted: E change, but e dey hidden
admin.audit.diff.empty: Dem no record any field detail.
admin.audit.empty.title: No event match dis filters
admin.audit.empty.body: Try longer date range or remove one filter. We no dey keep event wey pass 7 years again.
admin.audit.export.title: Export di audit log
admin.audit.export.body: We go email di link go your own address, nobody else own.
admin.audit.export.format.json.note: E dey keep di before and after detail
admin.audit.export.scope.filtered.note: Na only di events wey you dey see now
admin.audit.export.scope.last_90_days.no: Everything from di last 90 days wey you fit see
admin.audit.export.ip.note: E dey off by default. IP address na personal data, and if you turn am on we go record am.
admin.audit.export.audited: Dis export sef dey recorded for di audit log.
admin.audit.export.queued: We go email di link go {hint}. E go expire after {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
admin.audit.export.queued.noHint: We go email di link go di address for your account.
admin.scripts.intro: Agents dey see di script wey match di channel and di language of each interaction. WhatsApp script must match template wey di provider don approve.
admin.scripts.col.name: Script
admin.scripts.empty.title: No script dey yet
admin.scripts.empty.body: Na for di script builder dem dey write script. Dem never add any one to dis programme.
admin.ret.notice: Dis rules dey replace di workspace default of {days}. Check di client contract and any sector rule before you cut any period short. Na general guide, no be legal advice.
admin.ret.notice.noDefault: Check di client contract and any sector rule before you cut any period short. Na general guide, no be legal advice.
admin.ret.unset.title: Retention rules never save yet
admin.ret.unset.body: This programme no get im own retention rules. Choose how long for each kind record and wetin go happen for the end, then save.
admin.ret.scope.note: Na di rules wey dem save for dis programme be dis. Call recordings wey di telephony platform dey hold dey follow dat platform own rule until dem join di two, so if you cut di period here e no go delete di audio by itself.
admin.ret.row.recordings.note: Di audio of every call wey enter and every call wey go out.
admin.ret.row.transcripts.note: WhatsApp, SMS and email threads, with di attachments.
admin.ret.row.screen.note: Agent desktop capture wey dem dey use for QA.
admin.ret.shortened: E short pass di rule wey dem save
admin.ret.onExpiry.delete.note: Dem go clear di files and text from storage and backup within 30 days.
admin.ret.onExpiry.anonymise: Comot name but keep di numbers
admin.ret.onExpiry.anonymise.note: Dem go comot names, numbers and ID. Counts and scores go remain for report.
admin.ret.redact: Hide card number, BVN and NIN for transcripts
admin.ret.redact.note: Dem dey replace am before dem store am. Recording dey pause wen agent dey collect card details.
admin.ret.hold.note: E dey stop all deletion for dis programme until you off am. Use am only wen di client or regulator ask.
admin.portal.empty.title: No client portal user dey yet
admin.portal.empty.body: Invite people from {client} make dem see live dashboard, QA score and report for dis programme. Dem no go ever see another client data.
admin.portal.empty.body.noClient: Invite people from di client make dem see live dashboard, QA score and report for dis programme. Dem no go ever see another client data.
admin.archive.title: You wan archive {name}?
admin.archive.body: Di programme go stop to collect new work sharp sharp. You fit bring am back within {days} days; after dat e go remain read-only.

signup.title: Open your workspace

signup.phone.label: Your phone number
signup.phone.help: We go text you code to check am. The number dey start with {dial} — change the country code if e no correct.
signup.company.label: Your company name
signup.country.label: Which country
signup.password.label: Password
signup.password.help: At least 12 letters. Short sentence dey easy to remember.
signup.employees.legend: How many people dey work for una
signup.bpo.title: Una be BPO or contact centre?
signup.bpo.on: Yes — we go on queues, agent status and wrap-up codes for una.
signup.bpo.off: No — una go start with simple shared inbox. Una fit on queues anytime.
signup.terms: If you open account, you don gree to the Terms and the Privacy notice.
verify.title: Check your email and your phone
verify.subtitle: We need the two so we fit reach you if wahala happen for your account.
verify.email.waiting: Open the link wey we email you
verify.phone.title: Put the code wey we text you
verify.emailPending: Your phone don confirm. Open the link inside the email wey we send, then come back continue.
verify.help: You no see the email? Check spam or Promotions. E dey come from no-reply@kasuwa.africa.
verify.missing: This page no get the details of your sign-up. Start again and we go send new codes.
region.title: Where we go keep your data?
region.subtitle: Na here your contacts, chats and call recordings go stay. To move am later need proper planned migration.
region.za.name: South Africa · Johannesburg
region.za.desc: E dey inside every plan. E fast for most of Africa.
region.ng.name: Naija · Lagos
region.ng.desc: E dey keep data inside Naija. For banks, fintechs and government work.
region.ke.name: Kenya · Nairobi
region.ke.desc: E best for teams wey mostly dey East Africa.
region.sales.note: Our sales team go set this region up with you. You no fit choose am during sign-up.
region.law.title: Wetin Naija data law (NDPA 2023) mean for you
region.law.guidance: Most times you fit keep Naija customers' data outside Naija if e dey well protected and you tell customers where e dey go. Kasuwa go sign data processing agreement with you and we no dey ever sell your data. If you be bank, fintech or you dey work with government, your regulator fit ask make data dey Naija.
region.law.sales: Na our sales team dey set up Naija data residency.
region.law.disclaimer: Na general guidance, e no be legal advice.
currency.title: Money and language

currency.legend: Main money wey una dey use
currency.teamLanguage.help: Each person fit change im own.
currency.timeZone.help: We find am from your browser.
currency.timeZone.detecting: We dey find your time zone…
currency.customerLanguages: Languages wey your customers dey use
currency.customerLanguages.help: We dey use am for message templates and to send chats go agents wey sabi the language.
whatsapp.title: Join WhatsApp Business
whatsapp.subtitle: Chat with customers where dem dey already. E go take like 5 minutes for Meta secure page.
whatsapp.need.title: Wetin you go need
whatsapp.need.number: Phone number wey no dey use WhatsApp app before
whatsapp.need.meta: Meta Business account — you fit open one during setup
whatsapp.need.registration: Your business registration (like CAC certificate) for verification
whatsapp.connect.note: E go open Meta window. Kasuwa no dey ever see your Facebook password.
whatsapp.connect.unavailable: To join WhatsApp never ready. Skip this step for now — you fit join am later from Settings.
whatsapp.window.title: The 24-hour window
whatsapp.window.body: When customer message you, you fit reply free for 24 hours. After that one, na only template messages wey dem don approve you fit send until dem write again.
whatsapp.cost.title: How much message dey cost
whatsapp.cost.note: Meta dey set price for each country and dem dey change am from time to time. We dey charge Meta price, we no add anything, and we dey show live rates for Billing.
import.title: Bring your contacts and deals come
import.subtitle: We dey copy your data. Nothing go change for your old tool.
import.crm.body: Enter {name} and choose wetin you wan bring: contacts, companies, deals and notes. Big accounts fit take some hours — we go email you when e finish.
import.crm.unavailable: To join {name} never ready. You fit bring CSV file instead, or skip this step for now.
import.csv.help: Excel files: save dem as CSV first. Na only the column names we dey read for this page.
import.csv.unreadable: We no fit read that file. Save am as CSV and try again.
import.startFresh: Nothing to bring come? Start fresh. You fit bring data anytime from Settings → Data.
invite.title: Invite your team come
invite.subtitle: Add the people wey go answer chats and calls. You fit change their roles later.
invite.emails.label: Email addresses dem
invite.emails.help: Paste plenty at once — separate dem with comma or new line.
invite.link.body: Share link for your team WhatsApp group. People wey join go enter as Agents and dem go wait make you approve dem.
invite.link.unavailable: Invite links never ready. Use email invite for now.
invite.empty.title: You never invite anybody
invite.empty.body: E no matter — you fit invite people anytime from Settings → Team.
invite.count: People wey dey the invite list: {count}

done.item.whatsapp.detail: Reply customers for the app wey dem dey use every day.
